Procedure
step 1 Cut the cube of potato into two pieces.
step 2 Place one piece of potato into each of two test‑tubes.
step 3 Add about 2 cm depth of biuret solution to one of these test‑tubes.
step 4 Add a few drops of iodine solution to the other test‑tube.
step 5 Add about 2 cm depth of milk to each of two clean test‑tubes.
step 6 Repeat steps 3 and 4 with the milk instead of the potato pieces.
Record in your results table in (a)(i) the final colours observed in each test‑tube.
